scope: Reconcile both Git histories and publish the audited source tree, preserving later SEO and owner changes.
database_changes: None. Keep the existing production WordPress database and options.
media_changes: None on the production uploads volume. Keep all existing attachments and files.
preserve: Published post IDs, slugs, content and locale metadata
glc_settings including google_rating, google_maps_url, analytics IDs and redirect overrides
Existing testimonials, review metadata and booking records
Canonical, hreflang, sitemap, schema, IndexNow and legacy URL redirect implementations
ordinary_update_procedure: Use Procedure A in docs/ORACLE-DEPLOYMENT-HANDOFF.md if deployment is separately requested. Do not run import.php, import-fleet.php, setup-reputation-trust.php or bulk setup scripts during this source-only update.
history_policy: Keep both prior histories as merge ancestors. Push main by fast-forward; do not force-push.
